note: Explicit per-ticker vocabulary pack overrides, applied IN ADDITION to whatever a ticker's Yahoo Finance industry (MarketDataLibrary securities.industry, via vocabulary/symbol_industry.json + vocabulary/industry_packs.json) already assigns. Use this only when a ticker's classification is missing, wrong, or the company genuinely spans more than its industry suggests -- not as the primary mechanism: most tickers should need no entry here at all, because they resolve automatically from their industry. CPRT and VICI are kept here as a safety net for the two calls already validated against gold, even though both should also resolve automatically (Copart via its own industry, VICI as a REIT).
